result.title: Biology-Guided Context-Aware Residual Propagation for Spatial Gene Expression Prediction from Histology
result.comment: Accepted at The IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision 2027
result.summary: Spatial transcriptomics provides spatially resolved molecular profiling, but its cost, limited throughput and experimental complexity hinder routine large-scale use. Predicting spatial gene expression from hematoxylin-and-eosin-stained histology images offers a scalable alternative, yet remains challenging because histology provides only an indirect morphological view of molecular activity. Existing methods typically decode expression from visual features in a single stage, even when enhanced with spatial aggregation, retrieval or multi-resolution fusion. This formulation is restrictive because spot-level expression reflects not only local morphology but also cellular identity, neighborhood composition and tissue-level organization. We propose BCARP, a Biology-guided Context-Aware Residual Propagation framework for histology-guided spatial transcriptomics prediction. Instead of directly predicting gene expression from histology embeddings, BCARP treats them as morphology visual priors and progressively refines spot representations in a transcriptomics-oriented latent space. Each refinement step integrates nuclei-guided local cellular context with prototype-guided global context propagation, enabling information exchange across both neighboring and spatially distant spots. A pattern-scale decoder further separates spatial expression into pattern prediction from raw expression with scale calibration. Evaluated on three ST datasets and ten HEST-1k cohorts, BCARP achieves the highest mean correlation-based performance against other baselines. Numerical results support biology-guided local-global residual propagation as an effective alternative to visual decoding for histology-to-transcriptomics prediction.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 BCARP，把组织学图像嵌入仅当作形态学视觉先验，在面向转录组的潜在空间中通过核引导的局部细胞上下文与原型引导的全局传播逐步残差精化 spot 表示，并用 pattern-scale 解码器把表达拆成模式预测与尺度校准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其多步 latent 精化及跨近邻与远距离 spot 的全局上下文传播，可能为 LVR 的迭代状态更新、视觉旁路信息保留提供可供核查的方法线索，但任务本身是基因表达回归而非 VLM 推理。
